title: SF264 (2023-2024 Regular): Permissible methods of submitting an application expansion for a permit to carry a handgun

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-11; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/264/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced, 2023-01-11. The bill strikes the word "must" before "be submitted" (old law required in-person filing). No votes recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): Applications may be submitted in person, electronically, or by facsimile, certified mail, or certified delivery.
